name: Z-Image Turbo

prompt.note: sd.cpp's example uses Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the text encoder.

negative_prompt.note: The card samples with guidance 0 and sd.cpp at cfg 1: CFG off, so a negative prompt has no effect.

resolution.note: 1024x1024 is the card's example size (sd.cpp's example renders 512x1024). The multiple of 16 is likely but unconfirmed.

sampling.steps.note: Diffusers' example passes 9 steps, which is 8 forward passes; sd.cpp's --steps 8 is the same schedule.

sampling.cfg.note: The card's guidance 0 is CFG off; sd.cpp writes CFG off as cfg 1.

warnings.message: Z-Image Turbo runs without CFG at its recommended settings, so the negative prompt has no effect.

notes: Steps: Diffusers' 9 and sd.cpp's 8 describe the same 8 forward passes; the profile uses sd.cpp's count, since its adapter is the first.
CFG: the card's guidance 0 and sd.cpp's cfg 1 both mean CFG off; the profile uses sd.cpp's convention.
No sampler or scheduler default: neither is confirmed, so the route's own default applies.
